reason: Twenty narrow derived-state directives cover recoverable upload/scout receipts, token-fenced claims, grant parking and replay, scheduler due slots and atomic schedule repair, deferred completion-notice outcomes, and search projection maintenance moved out of request-only readers. Primary entity/import/definition writes and emitted signals keep their owning transaction audits; scheduler runs and scout census rows retain attempts. Operational recorders return no feature data. The additional six directives replace moved legacy audit-ledger owners or cover newly required delivery/scheduling recovery state.
